Name: ArcGIS Enterprise
Description: ArcGIS Enterprise is a powerful mapping and analytics platform designed for organizations to visualize, analyze, and manage spatial data across infrastructure and the cloud. It provides advanced tools for creating interactive maps, performing spatial analysis, and sharing geospatial insights securely. With scalable deployment options, ArcGIS Enterprise enables seamless integration with enterprise systems, supporting informed decision-making and collaboration across teams.

Name: ArcGIS Solutions
Description: ArcGIS Solutions by Esri is a collection of pre-configured, industry-specific workflows and apps designed to streamline operations using the ArcGIS platform. They cater to sectors like public safety, utilities, transportation, and more, offering tools for efficient data management, spatial analysis, and decision-making. These solutions are easy to deploy, integrate with ArcGIS, and can be used in both cloud and on-premises environments.

Name: FortiSIEM - Security Information Event Management
Description: FortiSIEM is a comprehensive Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) solution that provides real-time monitoring, threat detection, and incident response. It helps organizations identify and respond to security incidents quickly by collecting, analyzing, and correlating log data from various sources.

Name: FortiPAM - Privileged Access Management
Short description: FortiPAM provides privileged account and credential management and session monitoring. With capabilities such as credential discovery and onboarding, secure password and certificate storage, password rotation, session monitoring and recording, and reporting, FortiPAM provides control over privileged access.

Name: FortiAnalyzer
Short description: FortiAnalyzer is a centralized logging and analytics platform designed to provide advanced visibility into network security events. It collects, correlates, and analyzes log data from Fortinet devices and other security infrastructure, helping organizations monitor security incidents, detect threats, and maintain compliance.

Name: FortiManager
Short description: FortiManager is a centralized management platform for Fortinet security devices, allowing organizations to streamline the deployment, configuration, and monitoring of their Fortinet network security solutions. It provides centralized control over FortiGate firewalls, FortiAPs, FortiSwitches, and other Fortinet products, enabling efficient policy management, system monitoring, and reporting. FortiManager simplifies tasks like firmware updates, backup, and security policy enforcement, improving operational efficiency and enhancing the overall security posture of the network.

Name: Fortinet NGIPS
Short description: Fortinet NGIPS (Next-Generation Intrusion Prevention System) is a network security solution designed to detect and prevent advanced threats in real-time. It combines deep packet inspection, traffic analysis, and threat intelligence to identify and block malicious activity, including exploits, malware, and botnets. FortiGate NGIPS integrates seamlessly with Fortinet's security fabric, providing centralized control and visibility. It delivers proactive threat protection, reduces false positives, and enhances overall network security by securing both on-premises and cloud environments.

Name: Cisco Endpoint Security
Short description: Provides comprehensive protection for endpoints (e.g., laptops, desktops, mobile devices) against malware, ransomware, and advanced threats, ensuring secure access to corporate networks.

Name: Cisco AnyConnect
Short description: A VPN solution that provides secure remote access to corporate networks, ensuring users can securely connect to their organization's resources from anywhere, anytime, using various devices.

Name: Cisco Identity Services Engine
Short description: A policy management platform that enables organizations to enforce access control, visibility, and compliance across the network by authenticating, authorizing, and accounting for users and devices.

Name: Cisco MFA - DUO
Short description: A multi-factor authentication (MFA) solution that enhances security by requiring users to provide multiple forms of identification before gaining access to systems, ensuring better protection against unauthorized access.

Name: Cisco Email Security Access
Description: Cisco Email Security Access Software is an advanced solution designed to protect businesses from email-based threats, including phishing, malware, spam, and ransomware. It offers secure email gateway protection, advanced threat defense, and data loss prevention (DLP) to safeguard sensitive communications and ensure compliance with security regulations.

Name: Cisco Web Security Gateway
Short description: Cisco Web Security Gateway (WSG) is a cloud-delivered security solution designed to protect users from web-based threats. It provides comprehensive protection against malware, phishing, and other malicious content while ensuring secure access to the internet. Cisco WSG uses advanced technologies such as URL filtering, cloud security intelligence, and threat detection to enforce policies and secure web traffic. It helps organizations monitor, control, and optimize web traffic while safeguarding sensitive data and maintaining compliance with security policies.
Categories: Software > Email\, Web & Network Security, Software

Name: Cisco Advanced Malware Protection
Short description: Cisco Advanced Malware Protection (AMP) is a security solution that provides real-time protection, detection, and response against advanced malware and cyber threats. It leverages machine learning, behavioral analysis, and threat intelligence to identify and block threats across endpoints, networks, and emails. AMP offers continuous monitoring, advanced analytics, and automated responses to help organizations detect, investigate, and remediate security incidents effectively. It enables proactive threat defense and helps minimize the impact of malware attacks on businesses.

Name: Cisco Umbrella
Short description: Cisco Umbrella is a cloud-based security platform that provides comprehensive protection against cyber threats by securing user internet activity. It offers features like DNS-layer security, content filtering, and threat intelligence to prevent access to malicious websites, block phishing attempts, and reduce the risk of malware. Cisco Umbrella works by enforcing security policies before users connect to harmful sites, regardless of their location, making it ideal for remote and mobile workforces. It helps organizations enhance security, improve compliance, and ensure safer internet access.

Name: Cisco Secure Access
Description: Cisco Secure Access is a comprehensive solution designed to provide secure, seamless access to applications and data for users, regardless of their location or device. It integrates identity and access management (IAM) with robust security controls, ensuring that only authorized users can access critical resources. Cisco Secure Access uses advanced authentication, zero-trust policies, and adaptive risk assessments to safeguard access to corporate networks, applications, and data. This solution enhances security while enabling organizations to support remote work and cloud-based environments efficiently.

Name: Cisco NGIPS
Description: Cisco Next-Generation Intrusion Prevention System (NGIPS) is an advanced security solution designed to detect and prevent cyber threats in real time. It combines traditional signature-based detection with advanced techniques like machine learning, behavior analysis, and deep packet inspection. Cisco NGIPS provides comprehensive protection against known and unknown threats, including malware, ransomware, and advanced persistent threats (APTs). With its high-performance capabilities and integration with other Cisco security solutions, NGIPS helps organizations secure their networks by proactively identifying and blocking malicious activity before it can cause harm.

Name: SPSS Statistics
Description: SPSS Statistics is a powerful software suite used for statistical analysis, data management, and predictive analytics. It provides tools for performing a wide range of statistical tests, data visualization, and advanced analytics, making it a popular choice for researchers, data scientists, and businesses. SPSS is user-friendly and offers a variety of options for analyzing complex datasets, such as regression analysis, hypothesis testing, and multivariate analysis. It helps users uncover insights, identify trends, and make data-driven decisions.
Categories: Software > Data Analysis & SIEM Solutions, Software

Name: QRadar
Description: IBM QRadar is a comprehensive security information and event management (SIEM) solution designed to detect, analyze, and respond to cybersecurity threats in real time. It collects and correlates data from various sources, such as network devices, endpoints, and security systems, to identify suspicious activity and potential security breaches. QRadar uses advanced analytics, machine learning, and threat intelligence to provide insights into security incidents and support incident response. It helps organizations improve threat detection, streamline compliance reporting, and enhance overall security posture.

Name: Identity and Access Management
Description: Identity and Access Management (IAM) is a comprehensive solution that helps organizations manage and secure user identities, authentication, and access to critical resources. It provides tools for managing user accounts, enforcing access policies, and ensuring secure authentication across applications and systems. IBM IAM includes features like single sign-on (SSO), multi-factor authentication (MFA), and role-based access control (RBAC), helping organizations enhance security, streamline user access, and ensure compliance with regulatory requirements. It enables organizations to protect sensitive data and reduce the risk of unauthorized access.

Name: Trellix (McAfee)
Description: Trellix offers a comprehensive suite of cybersecurity products designed to provide advanced protection, detection, and response across various IT environments. Its solutions include endpoint security, network defense, cloud protection, email security, and data loss prevention (DLP). Leveraging machine learning, behavioral analytics, and automation, Trellix products help organizations defend against evolving cyber threats, detect anomalies in real time, and respond to incidents efficiently. The suite is integrated for seamless security management, providing visibility, control, and advanced threat intelligence to safeguard businesses against data breaches, malware, and other malicious activities.

Name: Veeam Backup solutions
Description: Veeam Backup solutions provide comprehensive data protection and disaster recovery for virtual, physical, and cloud environments. It enables fast and reliable backup, replication, and recovery of critical data across on-premises and cloud-based infrastructures. Veeam's solutions offer features like high-speed recovery, flexible storage options, and automated backup management, ensuring businesses can quickly restore operations in case of data loss or system failure. Veeam Backup helps organizations improve data availability, minimize downtime, and support compliance requirements for data protection.

Name: Vmware
Description: VMware is a global leader in cloud infrastructure and digital workspace technology. It provides software solutions that enable organizations to virtualize their IT environments, allowing them to run multiple operating systems and applications on a single physical server. VMware's products, such as VMware vSphere, VMware Cloud, and VMware Workspace ONE, help businesses improve efficiency, scalability, and flexibility by simplifying infrastructure management, enhancing security, and enabling seamless cloud integration. VMware solutions support both on-premises and cloud environments, helping organizations drive innovation and reduce operational costs.

Name: HPE Zerto
Description: HPE Zerto is a disaster recovery and business continuity solution that provides rapid, automated data protection and recovery for virtual, cloud, and hybrid environments. It offers continuous data replication, allowing organizations to recover applications and data with minimal downtime in the event of an outage or disaster. HPE Zerto helps businesses ensure high availability, meet recovery time objectives (RTO), and safeguard critical workloads across on-premises and cloud platforms. With its simplified management and scalable architecture, it helps improve resilience and reduce the complexity of disaster recovery planning.

Name: HPE SANnav
Description: HPE SANnav is a management software platform designed for monitoring and managing Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) Storage Area Networks (SANs). It provides a centralized interface for administrators to oversee SAN infrastructure, optimize performance, and troubleshoot issues. HPE SANnav offers features such as real-time monitoring, health checks, topology visualization, and automated diagnostics, helping organizations ensure their storage networks are running efficiently and securely. It simplifies SAN management, improves operational visibility, and enhances the overall reliability of data storage environments.

Name: Windows Servers
Description: Windows Server is a powerful operating system designed for enterprise environments, providing secure, scalable, and reliable infrastructure for managing applications, data, and networks. It offers advanced features such as Active Directory, virtualization, cloud integration, and enhanced security to support business operations. With flexible deployment options, Windows Server enables organizations to run workloads on-premises, in the cloud, or in hybrid environments.

Name: Microsoft Office Home & Business
Description: Microsoft Office Home & Business is a productivity suite designed for home users and small businesses. It includes essential applications such as Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook, offering tools for word processing, data analysis, presentations, and email management. This version is licensed for use on a single PC or Mac and provides users with the core tools they need for everyday business tasks, personal projects, and communication, helping improve productivity and collaboration in both home and small business environments.

Name: Microsoft 365 subscriptions
Description: Microsoft 365 subscriptions offer a suite of cloud-based productivity tools designed to enhance collaboration, communication, and efficiency. These subscriptions provide access to a variety of apps, including Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and OneDrive, along with advanced features like cloud storage, real-time collaboration, and security features. Available in different plans for individuals, families, businesses, and enterprises, Microsoft 365 allows users to work seamlessly across devices, access updates and new features, and benefit from ongoing support. The subscription model ensures that users always have the latest tools and services to meet their needs.

Name: Microsoft Windows OS
Description: The latest version of Microsoft Windows OS is Windows 11, which offers a modern, streamlined interface designed for enhanced productivity and user experience. It features a centered Start Menu, improved window management with Snap Layouts, and better integration with virtual desktops. Windows 11 also focuses on performance, security, and support for the latest hardware technologies, such as TPM 2.0 for enhanced security and support for DirectStorage and Auto HDR for gaming.

Name: Barracuda NGIPS
Description: Barracuda NGIPS (Next-Generation Intrusion Prevention System) is an advanced security solution designed to detect and prevent network threats in real time. It provides deep packet inspection, behavioral analysis, and threat intelligence to protect against malware, exploits, and unauthorized access. With automated threat response, seamless integration with security ecosystems, and scalable deployment options, Barracuda NGIPS ensures robust network protection for enterprises and cloud environments.
Categories: Software > Email\, Web & Network Security, Software

Name: Barracuda Web Security Gateway
Description: The Barracuda Web Security Gateway is a security solution that helps organizations protect against web-based threats. It provides advanced web filtering, malware detection, and data loss prevention (DLP) to secure internet traffic. The system enforces corporate policies, prevents access to malicious websites, and controls employee web usage, while also offering detailed reporting and real-time threat protection. It's designed to safeguard against both external and internal web-based risks in a scalable, easy-to-manage appliance or cloud-based solution.
Categories: Software > Email\, Web & Network Security, Software

Name: Barracuda Email Security Gateway
Description: The Barracuda Email Security Gateway is an email protection solution that helps organizations defend against spam, malware, phishing attacks, and other email-borne threats. It provides advanced filtering, encryption, and data loss prevention (DLP) features to ensure secure, compliant email communications. The gateway blocks harmful emails, enforces security policies, and reduces the risk of data breaches, while offering easy integration with existing email platforms like Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace. It also provides detailed reporting and real-time threat intelligence.
Categories: Software > Email\, Web & Network Security, Software

Name: Barracuda Load Balancer
Short description: The Barracuda Load Balancer is a solution designed to distribute incoming network traffic across multiple servers to ensure high availability, reliability, and optimized performance for applications. It offers advanced load balancing, SSL offloading, application health monitoring, and traffic management features. By preventing server overload and minimizing downtime, it helps ensure a seamless user experience. Additionally, the Barracuda Load Balancer can be deployed in physical, virtual, or cloud environments, making it a versatile solution for scaling applications and enhancing performance.

Name: Xerox Docushare
Description: Xerox DocuShare is a cloud-based document management and collaboration platform that helps organizations store, organize, and share documents securely. It enables users to manage content, automate workflows, and improve team collaboration by providing features like document versioning, access control, search functionality, and workflow automation. DocuShare supports both physical and digital document management, making it easier to streamline business processes, reduce paper usage, and improve efficiency. It’s designed for easy integration into existing business systems and is scalable to meet the needs of various organizations.

Name: DocuSign - Electronic Signature
Description: DocuSign is an electronic signature solution that allows individuals and businesses to sign, send, and manage documents digitally in a secure and legally binding way. It streamlines the signing process by eliminating the need for paper-based workflows, enabling faster transactions and improved efficiency. With features like customizable templates, audit trails, and multi-party signing, DocuSign ensures secure, compliant, and seamless document management across various industries. It integrates with other business applications, making it a convenient choice for organizations of all sizes.

Name: Forcepoint Web Security Gateway
Description: Forcepoint Web Security Gateway is a comprehensive web security solution that helps organizations protect against web-based threats, data breaches, and malicious content. It offers advanced features like real-time threat intelligence, URL filtering, malware protection, and data loss prevention (DLP). By controlling user web access and securing web traffic, it ensures compliance and safeguards sensitive data. The solution is designed to protect users both on and off the network, providing granular policy enforcement, detailed reporting, and seamless integration with other security systems.
Categories: Software > Email\, Web & Network Security, Software

Name: Forcepoint Email Security Gateway
Description: Forcepoint Email Security Gateway is a robust email protection solution designed to safeguard organizations from email-borne threats such as spam, phishing, malware, and advanced persistent threats (APTs). It provides advanced filtering, content inspection, data loss prevention (DLP), and encryption to ensure secure and compliant email communications. The solution protects against both inbound and outbound threats, blocking malicious attachments and links, while offering real-time threat intelligence and detailed reporting for proactive security management.
Categories: Software > Email\, Web & Network Security, Software

Name: Forcepoint Data Loss Prevention
Description: Forcepoint Data Loss Prevention (DLP) is a security solution designed to protect sensitive data from unauthorized access, sharing, or leakage. It uses advanced machine learning and behavioral analytics to monitor and enforce data security policies across endpoints, networks, and cloud environments. Forcepoint DLP helps organizations prevent data breaches by identifying and controlling the movement of confidential information, both inside and outside the organization. It offers customizable policy enforcement, real-time alerts, and detailed reporting to ensure compliance and safeguard valuable data.
Categories: Software > Email\, Web & Network Security, Software

Name: Qualys Vulnerability Management
Description: Qualys Vulnerability Management is a comprehensive security solution that helps organizations identify, prioritize, and remediate vulnerabilities across their IT infrastructure. It provides continuous scanning and real-time visibility into vulnerabilities in networks, applications, and systems. By offering automated asset discovery, risk assessment, and reporting, Qualys enables security teams to efficiently manage vulnerabilities and reduce the risk of breaches. The platform integrates with other security tools, streamlining vulnerability management processes and ensuring compliance with industry standards and regulations.

Name: ME ServiceDesk
Description: ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus is an IT service management (ITSM) solution designed to streamline and automate IT support tasks. It provides features like incident management, problem management, change management, and service request management, helping IT teams resolve issues quickly and improve service delivery. With customizable workflows, a self-service portal, and robust reporting tools, ServiceDesk Plus enhances productivity, ensures compliance, and supports ITIL best practices. The solution is available in both on-premises and cloud-based deployments, making it scalable for organizations of any size.
Categories: Software > IT Service & Help Desk Management, Software

Name: ME Endpoint Central
Description: ManageEngine Endpoint Central is an integrated endpoint management solution that helps organizations manage and secure desktops, laptops, servers, and mobile devices from a single console. It offers features like patch management, software deployment, remote troubleshooting, IT asset management, and security compliance. With automated tasks, real-time monitoring, and detailed reporting, Endpoint Central enables IT teams to streamline operations, improve productivity, and ensure the security of all endpoints across the network. \n \n

Name: ME Patch Management
Description: ManageEngine Patch Manager Plus is a comprehensive patch management solution that helps organizations automate the process of discovering, deploying, and managing patches for operating systems and third-party applications. It ensures that endpoints are up-to-date with the latest security patches, reducing vulnerabilities and minimizing the risk of cyber threats. The solution offers features like automated patch deployment, detailed reporting, compliance management, and scheduling of patch installations across a variety of devices. Patch Manager Plus helps improve IT security and operational efficiency by ensuring timely and accurate patching across the network.

Name: ME Log 360 - SIEM
Description: ManageEngine Log360 -SIEM is a comprehensive Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) solution that helps organizations monitor, detect, and respond to security threats in real-time. It collects, analyzes, and correlates log data from various IT systems, applications, and devices to identify suspicious activities and potential security breaches. With advanced threat intelligence, compliance reporting, and customizable alerts, Log360 helps IT teams ensure security, enforce compliance with regulations like GDPR and HIPAA, and maintain the integrity of their network. The solution also offers incident response and forensic analysis capabilities to investigate security events.
Categories: Software > Data Analysis & SIEM Solutions, Software

Name: Symantec Antivirus
Description: Symantec Antivirus (now part of NortonLifeLock) is a robust security solution designed to protect computers and networks from viruses, malware, and other cyber threats. It provides real-time protection, automatic updates, and advanced scanning to detect and remove harmful software. Symantec Antivirus also offers features like email protection, firewall defense, and vulnerability scanning to enhance overall security. With its proactive threat detection and comprehensive malware protection, Symantec Antivirus helps ensure that devices remain safe from evolving online threats.

Name: Symantec EDR
Description: Symantec Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) is a security solution designed to provide advanced threat detection, investigation, and response capabilities for endpoints. It helps organizations identify and respond to sophisticated cyber threats, including malware, ransomware, and zero-day attacks, by continuously monitoring endpoint activity. Symantec EDR offers real-time alerts, detailed forensic data, automated incident response, and advanced analytics to detect anomalies and malicious behavior. It empowers security teams to quickly contain and mitigate threats, ensuring better protection for endpoints across the network.

Name: BeyondTrust PRA - Privileged Remote Access
Description: BeyondTrust Privileged Remote Access (PRA) is a comprehensive solution designed to securely manage and monitor remote access to critical systems for third-party vendors, contractors, and internal users. It provides a centralized platform for controlling and auditing access to sensitive IT environments, ensuring compliance and minimizing security risks. Key features include secure access without requiring VPNs, session recording, real-time monitoring, and integration with other BeyondTrust tools for privilege management. This solution helps organizations mitigate risks associated with external or internal remote access while ensuring that only authorized users have access to privileged resources.

Name: BeyondTrust Privileged Access Management
Description: BeyondTrust Privileged Access Management (PAM) is a security solution that helps organizations manage and control access to critical systems and sensitive data. It enforces least-privilege access, monitors and audits user activities, and protects against insider threats. PAM provides secure management of privileged accounts, passwords, and session activities, ensuring compliance and minimizing the risk of unauthorized access.
